A [plain link](https://example.com) and one [with a title](https://example.com/x "The title").

An [uppercase scheme](HTTPS://EXAMPLE.COM) is linked, and its case is preserved.

A [relative link](/about), a [scheme-less one](example.com) and a [mailto link](mailto:a@example.com) are not linked.

Link text is parsed: [a **bold** link](https://example.com).

An unclosed [bracket stays literal.
